Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling westbound on a residential roadway in Baytown, Texas, when the front of the vehicle struck the
front of a vehicle driven by Driver 2, which was traveling eastbound in the same lane. The impact was low speed, but
both vehicles sustained front-end damage consistent with the reported collision. Driver 2 confirmed at the scene that
the collision occurred as Driver 1 described it. Two witnesses gave statements that matched this account, and
photographs taken at the scene show damage that lines up with the point and direction of impact. No prior damage to
either vehicle was noted by those present or identified in available records. A pasesnger was seated in the vehicle at
the time, and officers and witnesses confirmed that person's presence. Driver 1 reported pain in the right shoulder,
which respondnig personnel observed was consistent with the forces involved in the collision. Driver 1 is listed as a
named driver on the policy covering the vehicle involved. No citations were issued at the scene.
